test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Pleasent**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Pleasent**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Pleasant**'. • It means **'nice, enjoyable or friendly'.** (सुहाना, आनंददायक या सुखद) • *Example: I had a **pleasant** dream last night.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Persistent**: determined to continue doing something even though people say that you are wrong or that you cannot do it. (लोगों द्वारा मना या निरुत्‍साहित किए जाने के बावजूद किसी काम को करते रहने के लिए कृत संकल्‍प) • **Accountant**: a person whose job is to keep or examine the financial accounts of a business, etc. (व्यापार आदि का वित्तीय लेखा-जोखा रखनेवाला व्यक्ति; लेखाकार, एकाउंटेंट) • **Reluctant**: not wanting to do something because you are not sure it is the right thing to do. (अनिच्‍छुक) 36:T5b1, The erroneous part is** 'in the time'.**
